extracted.name: Cream cheese & cucumber sandwiches
extracted.description: Make these simple, traditional cucumber and soft cheese sandwiches to include in an afternoon tea spread
ingredient_lines: 12 slices of bread half white, half brown
300g soft cheese (use light if you prefer)
instruction_lines: Spread the white bread and brown bread with some soft cheese. Season.
Layer the cucumber on half the bread and sandwich with the other half of the slices. Trim the crusts, then cut each into 4 fingers.
